blocks.text: Once again we are here at a wonderful time of the year to celebrate the birth of our Lord Jesus. When Jesus was born many events were happening in the heavens showing the coming of the Lord Jesus. Now the heavens have also been speaking of His return. Many celestial events have happened this year especially eclipses at unusual times. This Christmas will not be any different. An unusual total eclipse of the moon will take place on Dec. 21st, on the solstice, the first day of winter, visible from the Americas. What about next year? There will also be a solar eclipse Jan. 4, 2011. This has been a year of great events, but 2011 will be a total surprise of unexpected events far more severe than 2010. I will write more on this starting in our January letter. No matter what men do the gospel will always remain true. Jesus said these very things would occur just before His return. Signs in the heavens! – I have a wonderful Christmas letter from Brother Frisby’s library I know you will enjoy. And now a quote from Neal Frisby. “This is a good time to express our love for Jesus and to exalt and tell just who He is! The Bible says He is above ALL, and there is no other god or saviour before Him! But seemingly some men cannot believe this because of the humble way that He came as a baby!” St. Luke 2:7, “speaks of His humble arrival! Verse 9 shows the heavens lit up and glowed over the shepherds! Verse 10 associates great joy to all of us, so rebuke Satan, rejoice and accept this great joy, it is yours! Verse 11 reveals that He is our eternal creator! For unto you is born this day in the city of David a Saviour, which is Christ THE LORD! – (Jesus)” – “Verse 12 predicted the exact way that He would look! Verse 13 we see the angels shouting forth victory to the Great One and giving forth supreme praise! And so let us do the same, praise Him for your salvation, healing and everlasting life!” Matt. 1:23, “reveals the name Emmanuel which means God came to us in body and spirit!” Col. 1:16 reveals these infallible words, “All things were created by Him and for Him! Verse 17, He is before all things and by Him ALL things consist! Verse 18, He is the Omnipotent head! Verse 15 declares, He is the very image of the invisible God!” – “So there is no excuse and we should worship Him as both Lord and Saviour! Acts 2:36 says, This same Jesus whom ye have crucified, is both Lord and Christ!” If you believe these words, you have an eternal place with Him!

“St. John 13:13 tells it all, Ye call Me Master and Lord: and ye say well; for so I am. St. John 8:58, Jesus said unto them, Verily, verily I say unto you, before Abraham was, I am! And it was the MIGHTY I am, that I am, that met Moses at the burning bush!” (Ex. 3:14) – “Then in St. John 5:43 Jesus plainly says that He came in the Father’s name, and that is the Lord Jesus Christ! And to put the final Capstone words on this subject Jesus said in Matt. 28:18, ALL power is given unto me in heaven and earth! Believe, act and thank Him! All good things are yours by faith!” Isa. 9:6 calls Him the child which is the Mighty God, the everlasting Father . . . John 14:8-9. – Jesus declares Himself the Almighty! Rev.1:8. “I was reading these Scriptures and perhaps they will be a real blessing to you!” – “Great is our Lord and of great power: His understanding is infinite!” (Ps. 147:5) “He knows all of your needs and will lead you!” – “Trust in the Lord, lean not unto thine own understanding, in all thy ways acknowledge Him and He shall DIRECT thy paths!” (Prov. 3:5-6) – “And the Lord direct your hearts into the love of God and into the patient waiting for Christ.” (II Thess. 3:5) – “He is giving you peace, patience and rest! Praise Him!” – “Be strong and of good courage . . . for the Lord thy God . . . doth go with thee; he will not fail thee, nor forsake thee!” (Deut. 31:6) Yea, wait on the Lord and He shall strengthen thine heart! (Ps. 27:14)

The Lord’s people will be receiving more abundant power from Him; at the same time be on guard, for Satan will test the true body! – The Scriptures declare at this hour the elect will be persecuted by blasphemers, incoherent gossipers, rabble rousers, scoffers and blind guides! – But Jesus will pour out more love, joy and glory on the true believer in conjunction with this! – The Holy Spirit said, “That the trial of your faith, being much more precious than gold that perisheth, though it be tried with fire, might be found unto praise and honor and glory at the appearing of Jesus Christ!” (I Peter 1:7) “Yea, saith the Lord, the Almighty: shall bless thee with blessings of heaven above!” (Gen. 49:25) – “These Scriptures are true and faithful saith the Lord of Hosts.” – “The Eternal God is thy refuge and underneath is the everlasting arms!” (Deut. 33:27) – “Behold saith the Lord Jesus, believe ye this Scripture – As thy days, so shall thy strength be! (Deut. 33:25) And also shall thy spiritual blessings, protection and prosperity be as ye trust daily in My promises!” “And I will not just lead thee each month or year, but I will lead thee daily and guide thee in the light of my Holy Spirit! Yea, manifold wisdom and secrets will be given to My sheep who feed in the pasture of the Lord Jesus!” End quote.

Truly Brother Frisby could bring the birth of Christ like no other. His Christmas letters are so enjoyable. This month I have two Special Writings that will increase your faith, “The Creator Returns” and “Faith – Positive Power.” Also I am releasing a DVD called “Creation Declares the Creator” (See offer below.) – We have many exciting projects coming and I know you will want to be a part of it. Your help is truly appreciated. – Wishing all a Very Happy and Joyful Christmas Holiday and a Prosperous New Year!
